rules.summary: Use native CSS text-decoration shorthand, text-decoration-thickness, and text-underline-offset instead of border-bottom and padding-bottom underline hacks.

keepWhen: CSS border-bottom and padding-bottom underline simulation on inline text or link selectors paired with text-decoration: none
CSS linear-gradient underline background hacks on inline text or link elements paired with text-decoration: none
dropWhen: Block-level container borders (cards, tables, panels, modals, headers, footers)
Tab navigation component active state indicators (.tab, [role="tab"])
Rule declaring display: block, flex, or grid
Rule already declaring text-underline-offset or text-decoration-thickness

findings.message: Simulating text underline with border-bottom; native text-decoration with text-underline-offset and text-decoration-thickness avoids box-model side-effects and follows text wrapping.

note: Checked 33 guides (35 deterministic rules; ~20% of the guidance corpus). Finding 1 item here only reflects deterministic legacy patterns; use 'search <topic>' for the rest of the catalog.
